answer: A registry can ramp voting weight by age: a new identity starts at 5% weight and gains 5% per epoch only if it passes random re-attestation, so reaching the zenith takes 20 epochs. Each extra identity from one funding source needs a 40 POA lock that grows 25% per sibling, so a violet-flagged cluster of ten pays about 1,330 POA before reaching an oasis of full weight. Verifiers replay signed re-attestation logs from the ledger and zero the weight of any identity that skips two rounds.
